about.title: We care for your health and wellbeing
about.description: Dr. Aaron is a spine surgeon specializing in orthopedic and neurosurgery, with extensive professional experience and based in Extremadura, Spain. He trained at renowned centers of excellence in spine surgery in Spain, the United Kingdom, and the United States, consolidating his expertise in both disciplines. He holds a Doctorate in Medicine and Surgery from the University of Santiago de Compostela and has a long track record in research and academic publications.
about.approach: Dr. Aaron treats a wide range of spinal conditions, including sciatica, back pain (lumbago), neck pain, deformities in children and adults (scoliosis), trauma, infections, and tumors. Currently, his practice focuses on complex cases and revision surgeries. We are confident that we can offer you a balanced, highly competent, and confidential opinion regarding your back problems. Can we help you?
